paper.ref: Lai T., Liao K., Manthiram A., Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2026, 65, e22940
paper.group_note: DOL/DME 基准（1 M LiTFSI + 0.2 M LiNO3，1:1 v/v）中掺 30 vol% 单氧醚（MtBE、CPME、SBME、TAME）得 MSE；电池对比主要是 MSE-MtBE 对 DOL/DME。锂厚未写。E/S 5.5、4.5 只有 MSE-MtBE 软包，无同条件对照。作者称 MSE 与基准的 Li‖Li 去溶剂化活化能'相近'，MtBE 最小。Li2S6 对称电池 Rct：MSE-MtBE 更高，但活化能更低（作者归因电导率低）。GITT 中 MSE-MtBE 的 ηact、ηohm 更大、ηconc 更小，属同一测试内的分项此消彼长

DD.name: 1 M LiTFSI + 0.2 M LiNO3 DOL/DME（基准）
DD.label: 常规
DD.quote: The baseline electrolyte was composed of 1 M lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (LiTFSI, Solvionic) and 0.2 M LiNO3 (Sigma-Aldrich) in 1,3-dioxolane (DOL, Thermo Scientific) and 1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME, Oakwood Chemical) (v/v = 1: 1)

MT.name: MSE-MtBE（DOL/DME/MtBE 3.5:3.5:3）
MT.diluent: MtBE（单氧醚，弱溶剂化共溶剂）
MT.label: 适中溶剂化
MT.quote: Moderately solvating electrolytes (MSEs) were prepared by dissolving 1 M LiTFSI and 0.2 M LiNO3 in a mixture of DOL, DME, and a moderately solvating solvent (v/v/v = 3.5: 3.5: 3)

CP.name: MSE-CPME（DOL/DME/CPME 3.5:3.5:3）
CP.label: 适中溶剂化
CP.quote: Moderately solvating electrolytes (MSEs) were prepared by dissolving 1 M LiTFSI and 0.2 M LiNO3 in a mixture of DOL, DME, and a moderately solvating solvent (v/v/v = 3.5: 3.5: 3)

DDp.name: DOL/DME + 0.1 M Li2S6（Li2S6 对称电池）
DDp.label: 常规
DDp.quote: 0.1 M Li2S6 was added to the electrolytes for assembling Li2S6 symmetric cells

MTp.name: MSE-MtBE + 0.1 M Li2S6（Li2S6 对称电池）
MTp.label: 适中溶剂化
MTp.quote: 0.1 M Li2S6 was added to the electrolytes for assembling Li2S6 symmetric cells

descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是电解液本身（1 M LiTFSI + 0.2 M LiNO3）
descriptors.scale: 电解液 ⁷Li NMR 屏蔽排序（向低场移 = Li⁺–溶剂作用减弱）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=Li⁺–溶剂作用强）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. 2a）；DOL/DME −1.19 ppm，MSE 都向低场移，MtBE 与 SBME 移得最多；作者注明阴离子配对增强会屏蔽、溶剂作用减弱会去屏蔽，两者竞争；MD 中 DME 配位数同序。Li2S6 电解液（DDp/MTp）按无多硫化物时映射
descriptors.quote: Therefore, the fact that the 7Li peak shifts to greater downﬁeld in MSE-MtBE and MSE-SBME indicates their stronger ability to pull DME and DOL away from the Li+ ion, as well as their weaker interactions with Li+ ion, compared to other MSEs

descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是 0.1 M Li2S6 溶于混合溶剂（不含其他盐），按溶剂映射
descriptors.scale: 0.1 M Li2S6 溶液 ⁷Li NMR 排序（向低场移 = Li⁺–溶剂作用减弱、Li⁺–S6²⁻ 配对增多）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶剂化强）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. 3a）；DOL/DME 0.17 ppm、MtBE 混合 0.28 ppm；CPME 未向低场移，按与基准同档记
descriptors.quote: In the 7Li spectra, the peak downshifts from 0.17 ppm in DOL/DME to 0.28 ppm in MtBE (Figure 3a). Other MSEs also show a downﬁeld shift (except CPME), but less pronounced compared to MtBE

C1.quote: By utilizing the Aurbach method, coulombic efﬁciencies (CE) of Li plating and stripping were obtained for each electrolyte

C2.desc: 新鲜 Li‖Li 对称电池（LSV Tafel、变温 EIS + DRT；每侧 20 µL）
C2.quote: 20 μL of the electrolyte was added on each side for symmetric cells

C3.quote: the cell with MSE-MtBE demonstrates slightly lower plating and stripping overpotential and stable cycling for over 600 h at a current density of 1 mA cm−2, whereas the DOL/DME cell failed after 400 h

C4.desc: Li‖S 扣式（2.2 mg/cm²、C/3，1C = 1500；E/S 未写）
C4.cathode_material: S/喷雾干燥 KB（75 wt% S）85 + CNT 5 + C65 5 + PAA 4 + CMC 1
C4.rate_note: C/20、C/10 各一圈活化后 C/3
C4.quote: MSE-MtBE and DOL/DME baseline electrolytes were ﬁrst compared in cells with a relatively low S loading of 2.2 mg cm−2. Cycled at a rate of C/3 (1C = 1500 mA h g−1)

C5.cathode_material: S/喷雾干燥 KB（75 wt% S）85 + CNT 5 + C65 5 + PAA 4 + CMC 1
C5.rate_note: C/30 放电 + C/20 化成 + C/10 化成后 C/5
C5.quote: The electrolytes were then demonstrated with a higher S loading of 3.5–3.7 mg cm−2 and a lower E/S ratio of 10 µL mg s−1

C6.desc: Li‖S 倍率测试（3.5 mg/cm²、E/S 10、C/10 → C/2 → C/5、21 °C）
C6.cathode_material: S/喷雾干燥 KB（75 wt% S）85 + CNT 5 + C65 5 + PAA 4 + CMC 1
C6.rate_note: 倍率阶梯 C/10–C/2，再回 C/5
C6.quote: MSE-MtBE achieves higher and more stable capacities at all applied rates (from C/10 to C/2), especially at C/2, where it retains a capacity of 781 mA h g−1

C7.desc: Li‖S 扣式 45 °C（3.6 mg/cm²、E/S 10、C/5，前置 C/20×2、C/10×2 化成）
C7.cathode_material: S/喷雾干燥 KB（75 wt% S）85 + CNT 5 + C65 5 + PAA 4 + CMC 1
C7.quote: Li–S cells with high sulfur loading were further evaluated at an elevated temperature of 45 °C … With a sulfur loading of 3.6 mg cm−2, the DOL/DME baseline cell shows an initial capacity of 770 mA h g−1 at a C/5 rate

C8.desc: Li‖S 穿梭电流（放电中恒压 2.25 V；载量、E/S 未写）
C8.quote: a shuttling current test was performed on Li || S cells by holding the voltage at 2.25 V during discharge

C9.desc: Li‖S GITT-EIS（C/10，放电 15 min + 静置 75 min；'实用载量'未写数值）
C9.quote: Galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT) tests were performed at a C/10 rate. A constant discharge current was applied for 15 min, followed by a 75 min relaxation

C10.quote: Chronoamperometry curves of Li2S8 discharged at 2.08 V with different electrolytes

C11.desc: Li2S6 对称电池变温 EIS（0–50 °C）
C11.cathode_material: 对称电极 + 0.1 M Li2S6 电解液
C11.quote: These Rct values measured between 0 and 50 °C ﬁt well in an Arrhenius plot, from which activation energies were extracted

comparisons.author_judgement: MSE-MtBE 去溶剂化更易、SEI 富 LiF
comparisons.quote: MSEMtBE achieves the highest CE of 99.5% among all MSEs, whereas the DOL/DME electrolyte only realizes a CE of 98.0%

comparisons.author_judgement: MtBE 在 MSE 中 CE 最高
comparisons.quote: MSEMtBE achieves the highest CE of 99.5% among all MSEs

comparisons.unit: mA/cm²（Li‖Li 交换电流密度，越高越好）
comparisons.author_judgement: MSE 在锂金属上的电化学反应更快
comparisons.note: 原句是 MSEs 整体对 DOL/DME
comparisons.quote: MSEs exhibit higher exchange current densities compared to DOL/DME, indicating faster electrochemical reaction kinetics on Li metal

comparisons.author_judgement: Li⁺–溶剂作用减弱，去溶剂化更容易
comparisons.reason_quote: resulting from the weakened Li+-solvent interactions discussed before
comparisons.note: 原句是 MSEs 整体对 DOL/DME
comparisons.quote: MSEs show signiﬁcantly lower Rct compared to DOL/DME, resulting from the weakened Li+-solvent interactions discussed before

comparisons.unit: kJ/mol（去溶剂化活化能，越低越好）
comparisons.point: 新鲜电池，Rct 的 Arrhenius 拟合
comparisons.author_judgement: MSE 与基准活化能相近，MtBE 最小
comparisons.note: 作者先说 MSE 与基准'relatively similar'，再说 MtBE 最小；差多少只在图中
comparisons.quote: Note that MtBE indeed presents the smallest activation energy, proving its effectiveness in reducing not only the quantity, but also the strength of Li+-DME pairing through solvent-solvent interactions

comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/DME 在 C/2 下 10 圈后跌破 550
comparisons.rate_protocol: C/10 → C/2 阶梯（取 C/2 段）
comparisons.quote: especially at C/2, where it retains a capacity of 781 mA h g−1 (Figure 5b). In contrast, the DOL/DME cell only shows a capacity of 700 mA h g−1 and drops below 550 mA h g−1 after 10 cycles at C/2

comparisons.rate_protocol: C/10 → C/2 阶梯后回 C/5
comparisons.quote: the gap remains signiﬁcant after the rate changes back to C/5, as the MSE-MtBE cell recovers a capacity of ∼ 850 mA h g−1, while the baseline cell has less than 700 mA h g−1 retained

comparisons.author_judgement: 45 °C 下 DOL/DME 多硫化物溶解多、迁移快、与锂反应快，严重穿梭
comparisons.reason_quote: likely due to severe LiPS shuttling resulting from higher polysulﬁde solubility, faster migration, and its faster reaction with Li metal at higher temperatures
comparisons.quote: massive capacity drop at the ﬁrst formation cycle at C/20, with a low initial CE of only 38.5% … In sharp contrast, an initial CE of 79.7% in the formation cycle

comparisons.first_cap_note: MSE-MtBE 的 C/5 首圈容量未写
comparisons.quote: the DOL/DME baseline cell shows an initial capacity of 770 mA h g−1 at a C/5 rate and retains 627 mA h g−1 after 90 cycles … a capacity of 799 mA h g−1 can be retained after 90 cycles with the MSE-MtBE electrolyte

comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/DME 的 CE 在 30 圈后快速下降
comparisons.quote: Even at C/5, the CE rapidly decreases after 30 cycles and averages only 89.4% over the 90 cycles with the baseline electrolyte (Figure S27) … stable CEs with an average of 94.6% are achieved throughout the cycles

comparisons.author_judgement: 各 MSE 的 CE 次序与 ⁷Li 化学位移次序一致
comparisons.reason_quote: This suggests some degree of correlation between solvation structure and cycling performance as the CEs of different electrolytes match the sequence of chemical shifts in Li NMR
comparisons.quote: Other MSEs were tested for comparison, and MSE-MtBE has the highest and most stable CEs, and MSE-CPME shows the lowest CEs among MSEs

comparisons.author_judgement: 多硫化物溶解度降低、溶剂化受调控
comparisons.quote: As shown in Figure S15, the current in the DOL/DME cell quickly changes direction and levels off at ∼0.047 mA, indicating obvious LiPS shuttling. In contrast, the MSE-MtBE cell shows much slower current change, and the shuttle current stabilizes at ∼0.013 mA

comparisons.author_judgement: MSE-MtBE 多硫化物浓度低，成核位点少
comparisons.reason_quote: likely because of reduced LiPS concentration in MSE-MtBE, leading to fewer nuclei and nucleation sites
comparisons.quote: The MSE-MtBE cell shows a greater ηact at the Li2S/Li2S2 nucleation point (19.5 mV) compared to the baseline cell (10.4 mV)

comparisons.author_judgement: 多硫化物移动更容易、去溶剂化能更低
comparisons.reason_quote: This is likely due to easier LiPS movement and lower desolvation energy in MSE-MtBE
comparisons.note: 作者另称 75% DOD 前 MSE-MtBE 的 ηconc 略大，放电末段明显更小
comparisons.quote: In fact, the ηconc in MSEMtBE has a peak value of 44.7 mV at ∼25% DOD, which is lower than that in DOL/DME (47.4 mV)

comparisons.author_judgement: 离子电导率差异所致，ηohm 占比很小
comparisons.quote: The resulting ηohm for the MSE-MtBE cell is slightly greater than the DOL/DME cell due to their ionic conductivity difference, with both cells exhibiting a peak value at the nucleation point (2.81 mV for MSE-MtBE and 2.10 mV for DOL/DME)

comparisons.unit: mAh/g（恒压 Li2S 沉积容量，越高越好）
comparisons.author_judgement: 成核峰时间相近，同等多硫化物浓度下不影响成核速率
comparisons.quote: the MSE-MtBE cell achieves a higher response current peak and a larger Li2S deposition capacity of 232 mA h g−1, compared to 161 mA h g−1 for the DOL/DME cell

comparisons.author_judgement: 总反应速率较慢，可能因 MSE-MtBE 电导率低
comparisons.reason_quote: whereas the overall reaction rate is slower, plausibly due to the lower conductivity of MSE-MtBE
comparisons.quote: Interestingly, the MSE-MtBE cell exhibits higher Rct throughout the temperature range, but a lower activation energy compared to DOL/DME

comparisons.unit: kJ/mol（液–液转化电荷转移活化能，越低越好）
comparisons.author_judgement: 电活性表面去溶剂化势垒更低
